molecular.title: Molecular Sieves & Adsorbent Media
molecular.subtitle: Synthetic zeolites, activated aluminas, and silica gels engineered for deep dehydration, mercaptan removal, and gas stream purification.
molecular.process_text: Molecular sieves utilize precise crystalline pore structures to adsorb molecules based on kinetic diameter and polarity.

grades.3a_desc: Pore Size: ~3 Å. Optimized for selective water uptake without unsaturated hydrocarbon co-adsorption.
grades.4a_desc: Pore Size: ~4 Å. Standard choice for static and dynamic natural gas drying beds.
grades.13x_desc: Pore Size: ~10 Å. High surface area for deep CO2, H2S, and sulfur compound removal.
grades.list_3a: Type 3A: Cracked gas, ethanol, and unsaturated hydrocarbon dehydration.
grades.list_4a: Type 4A: Natural gas dehydration, air drying, and refrigerant loops.
grades.list_5a: Type 5A: Iso/normal paraffin separation and natural gas sweetening.
grades.list_13x: Type 13X: APG sweetening, CO2 removal from air feeds, and H2S/mercaptan traps.

molecular.compliance_text: All supplied adsorbent media comply with strict international quality standards, meeting ISO 9001 manufacturing traceability and EU REACH compliance requirements for industrial chemical handling.
molecular.bed_desc: Submit your gas flow rate, inlet pressure, temperature, and target dew point for custom bed volume calculation.
